heading: Limitations on use of financial assistance for certain purposes

tree.heading: Sectarian purposes and activities
tree.text: No financial assistance provided under this subchapter, pursuant to the choice of a parent under section 9858c(c)(2)(A)(i)(I) of this title or through any other grant or contract under the State plan, shall be expended for any sectarian purpose or activity, including sectarian worship or instruction.

tree.heading: Tuition
tree.text: With regard to services provided to students enrolled in grades 1 through 12, no financial assistance provided under this subchapter shall be expended for—

children.text: any services provided to such students during the regular school day;
any services for which such students receive academic credit toward graduation; or
any instructional services which supplant or duplicate the academic program of any public or private school.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 1992—Pub. L. 102–401 and Pub. L. 102–586 made identical technical corrections to directory language of Pub. L. 101–508, § 5082(2), which added this section.
